vb_textbox.text: It is important to be alert and answer quickly so you aren't timed out. I tended to find that the brown and dark purple taller hats would give the most reward. The exception to this was when a tall brown hat was against a small dark pink hat, in which case the dark pink seemed to be rated higher. I also found that after a while of the tall hats being the most profitable, it switched to the shorter hats for 5/10 goes and then returned.
